tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sgo nas 'chi med sgrub pa'i gdams ngag zla ba'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal ldan ye shes mgon po zhal bzhi pa// dkar po tshe dang bsod nams 'phel mdzad pa'i// chos skyong mchog dang dbyer med bla ma la// btud nas 'chi med grub pa'i gdams pa bri// de la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las/ lus dang sems ni brtan gyur na// bde ba thams cad brtan par 'gyur// de bas rnal 'byor bzang po kun// tshe ring ba ni dge ba'o// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar/ mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi gcig pu dal 'byor gyi lus yun ring du 'tsho ba'i thabs tshul lhur len pa shin tu gal che bas/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams nas tshe sring ba'i thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud nas legs par bstan cing*/ grub pa'i man ngag gis phye ba'i gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa'i chos skor la/ phyi bram ze/ nang zhing skyong*/ gsang ba stobs 'phrog dbang po ltar sgrub pa rnams kyi phyi ma la'ang bsnyen dus/ sgrub dus/ las sbyor/ dpogs chog shi sa bstan pa/ las bzhi/ gsang ba thung mong ma yin pa sogs mang du yod pa las/ 'dir las bzhi'i mgon po'i nang nas dkar po tshe 'phel la brten nas tshe sgrub pa la thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag cung zad gsal bar phye ba la gsum/ dang po lha nye bar bsnyen pa/ bar du dngos grub sgrub pa/ mthar grub pa'i bdud rtsis rang gzhan la phan gdags pa'i las kyi rim pa'o// dang po la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang dang*/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba man ngag dang bcas pa thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gces spras su byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas/

yar ngo'i gza' tshes legs pa'i snga dro'i char/ gnas khang bkra shis shing yid dang mthun pa la bsam gtan gyi tsher ma mi 'byung ba'i sar mtshams dam par bcad/ 'di nyid kyi bris sku sogs yod na bshams pa'i mdun du/ 'bul gtor dang mchod pa bsham/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos la/ rdo rje 'chang dbang 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang*// ba liṃ ta pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs// mar me mdzad dang grub chen dpal bde bar// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dri med sbas pa rin chen rnam pa gnyis// bsod snyoms pa dang gnyan lo dar ma grags// kha'u pa dang rje btsun sa skya par// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rje btsun sku mched chos rje khu dbon zhabs// zhang ston chos rje rje btsun brag phug pa// bla ma dam pa seng ge rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan// rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal// grub pa mchog brnyes rje btsun rdo ring par// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// tshar chen rje dang mai tri don grub zhabs// spyan snga mi pham dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// bsod nams mchog grub mkhyen rab byams pa la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rmor chen rje dang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i zhabs// legs pa'i 'byung gnas kun dga' blo gros dang*// kun dga' bkra shis kun dga' rin chen la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// snang stong lha skur shar ba'i mkha' dbyings su// grags stong rig sngags nam mkha'i rnga sgrar bcas// bde stong bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi rgyun babs pas// lhan skyes ye shes 'dzin ma rgyas par shog

/'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa// de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs zhal skong bcas sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes bdun nam nyer gcig tsam brjod pa'i mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshar gcig brjod pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sngags kyi bzlas brjod la brten nas tshe sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/

g.yas gnyis pas shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang g.yon gnyis pas pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang*/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs can/ ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i snying

'di la sa chen kun blos yan lag bzhi rdzogs dang sngags bzla ba yang gsungs 'dug kyang 'dir tshar chen dang rmor chen gyi gsung ltar ro// gar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ dkar po 'od du zhu ba las tsa turmu kha dkar po tshe 'phel sku mdog dung ltar dkar zhing nor bu chu shel ltar 'od 'phro ba/ zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ steng zhal dud ka rnams 'dzum zhing khro ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs shing*/ dbu skra dang sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas dang pos bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang*// g.yon dang pos thod pa tshe yi bdud rtsis gang ba gnyis thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsol ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pas tshe yi bar chad srung ba/ rin po che dang rus pa'i phreng ba dang g.yer kha'i drwa bas spras pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo sngon mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo dmar mo/ rgyab tu siṅga lī ser mo/ bzhi ka'ang 'dzum zhing khro ba/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ g.yon bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis gtso bo la phyogs pas bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad tsa turmu kha gtso 'khor lnga'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ 'dir yan lag phyi ma tshar chen gyis ma gsungs kyang rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pas/

slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ zhes brjod cing bsams la lha sku'i gsal snang la yun ring du sems 'dzin/ gnyis pa ni gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ dkar po'i mthar sngags phreng kha dog dkar po g.yas skor du 'khor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la tshe'i lha mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ sngags phreng hūm̐ yig dang bcas pa la thim/ de las 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar zhing dwangs pa dpag tu med pa skya chi li li babs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag lus sems bde ba chen pos khyab/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tṛ ta/ ḍom+bi nī tsaṇ+ḍa rak+kha sī siṅga lī de wī ma ma ā yur puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyi 'byung ba'i bcud/ nang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar gyi rnam par bsdus pa phyag gi bum thod kyi nang du thim pas/ bum pa'i nang nas thabs kyi bdud rtsi dkar po dang*/ thod pa'i nang nas shes rab kyi bdud rtsi dmar po lud cing phyur bas/

bdud rtsi dkar dmar bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis lus thams cad khyab/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes par bsam zhing sems 'dzin med kyi ngang du ci gnas bzhag rlung bum can mang du 'dzin/ gsum pa rjes ni/ thun las ldang ba na/ thal mo sbyar te/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po dkar po tshe 'phel 'khor dang bcas pas bdag gi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/ rang yi dam du gsal ba la thim/ de thugs ka'i yum bzhi la/ de gtso bo la/ de thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu ha la/ ha mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar spros bral gyi ngang du bzhag slar yang rang skad cig gis yi dam thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang*/ lo brgya thub cing sogs bsngo smon bkra shis ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ de ltar thun gsum mam bzhi bcad pas snga thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor mgron/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dmar po nas gnyis su med par thim par gong bzhin bskyed/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye zhing se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la sogs nas de wī sa pa ri wā ra na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs btags pa lan gsum mam lngas gtor ma/ sngags de nyid kyi mthar sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su gṛh+ṇa daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs sbyar bas phyi mchod/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod rnams phul la/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa dkar po tshe 'phel 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ byang chub ma thob bar du bsrung bskyab sba ba'i phrin las dang stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las bcol/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing*// mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba// sgra sgrogs dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi// gzhon nu'i lus can bgegs 'joms khyod la 'dud// g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang*// siṅga lar gnas rnal 'byor ma// dmar ser ljang nag khros pa'i zhal// gri gug thod 'dzin bstod par bya// de ltar bstod cing rab bsngags pas// bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang*// 'dod pa thams cad bsgrub pa dang*// bgegs rnams ma lus med par mdzod// gdong bzhi dregs pa rtsal chen 'khor bcas rnams// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dzam+bu ti pa'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /sman rag phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por 'bul// da bcol las kyi gsal 'debs gnyan por bzhes// 'khor rnams srung zhing rkyen rnams zlog pa dang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po// thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs// zhes dang*/ oṃ/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod// ces bstod cing bstab par bya'o// 'dod don gsol gdab/

yig brgya lan gsum/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ med na gshegs gsol/ dge bsngo bkra shis rnams spyi bzhin bya/ sngags kyi grangs 'bum phrag bzhi la sogs pa'am/ zhag nyer gcig gi bar du brtson pas nyams su blangs na dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba zlog cing*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa yang dag go /de dag ni bsnyen pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa bar du dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs la gnyis/ bdag don dang*/ gzhan don no// dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bsham/ dngos gzhi bdag mdun gyi rnal 'byor/ mjug thun mtshams kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sgrub gtor bum thod bcas pa dang*/ chos skyong gi mchod gtor sogs 'og rjes gnang gi skabs ltar dang*/ gzhan yang ji ltar dgos pa'i yo byad rnams bsham/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed do// dang po ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs rgyas bsdus gang rigs byas la/ skyabs 'gro nas thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba'i bar gong bzhin bya/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed la/ gtor ma dang bum thod a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po sogs nas/ gnyis su med par thim par gong bzhin/ gtor chu nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba dang*/ phyi nang mchod pa phrin bcol bstod bstab bcas gong bzhin/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i sogs nas/ chi li li babs pas bum pa dang thod pa bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang bar bsams la/ gtso bor bdag bskyed skabs kyi bzlas pa dang*/ spro na 'og tu rjes gnang gi skabs su bshad pa'i oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sogs kyang ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ slar yang sogs nas/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis bum pa dang thod pa'i nang gang bar bsams la sngags bzla/ gsum pa ni/ thun mtshams thams cad la mdo bklag pa/ sāts+tsha gdab pa/

srog bskyab pa/ gtor ma gtang ba sogs tshe bsring ba'i thabs la brtson par bya'o// gnyis pa gzhan don bya ba la/ sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni 'dra la/ gnyis pa la bdag mdun sgrub pa gtor ma gtang ba yan 'dra/ bzlas pa'i tshe/ gtso bo'i thugs ka sogs nas/ chi li li babs pas bar gong bzhin/ de'i mdun phyogs su zla ba'i gdan la bsgrub bya dngos su gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs lus kyi nang thams cad sogs nas/ dngos grub thams cad thob par gong bzhin/ bzla bya'i sngags kyi ma ma zhes pa'i mal du/ sbyin bdag gang yin gyis ming spel te dper na/ wā gin+d+ra dharma pā la bha dra s+ya ā yur sogs legs sbyar ram/ mi shes na de nyid bod skad du/ ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po'i ā yur puṇ+ye sogs sbrel/ 'on kyang de lta bu 'don stabs mi bde na ma ma zhes bod skad du bdag gi zhes par 'gyur bas bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i ngo bo dbyer med blo 'das brjod bral du shes pas/ rnam pa sbyin pa'i bdag po'i gzugs brnyan dngos su gsal ba la tshe bcud bsdu bstim gyi dmigs pa gsal snang brtan por bgyis pas kyang don grub pa yin no// gang ltar yang sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa sum brgya so gsum bzla/ slar yang thugs ka sogs nas/ rang bzhin gyis bar gong bzhin la/ bsgrub bya'i lus kyi nang thams cad la khyab pas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes par gyur ces dang*/ gong gi sngags bzhi brgya zhe bzhi bzla/ gsum pa ni/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dkar po tshe 'phel gtso 'khor lngas sbyin pa'i bdag po'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ sku tshe sku bsod thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod la skong gso byed par spro na 'dir bya zhing*/ mjug tu rtsa ltung bshags pa yang bya'o// gsum pa ni/

mjug chog yig brgya/ sku rten dang bzhugs khang gtor ma la'ang brtan bzhugs/ grol nyin mdun bskyed 'dod gsol rdzogs nas/ gtso 'khor lngar gsal ba 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun du zhu nas bsgrub bya'i dbu gtsug tu thim pas sku tshe dang sogs brjod/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis rnams skabs su gang bab bya'o// gsum pa tha mar grub pa'i bdud rtsis rang gzhan la phan gdags pa'i rim pa la gnyis/ bdag don dngos grub blang ba dang*/ gzhan don du 'chi med tshe'i rjes gnang sbyin pa'o// dang po ni/ sgrub pa zhag bdun gsum sogs ji ltar rigs pa grub pa'i sang nangs par dngos grub blang ba'i do nub nas mchod gtor sogs gsar pa bsham/ nangs par bdag mdun sgrub pa sogs dkyus ltar song rjes/ bum pa spyi bor blang zhing bum chu myang*/ thabs kyi ngo bo tshe chu dkar po sogs nas/ sngags bzla ba'i bar bya/ thod pa'i tshe chang yang de bzhin du byas la/ shes rab kyi ngo bo tshe'i sogs nas/ dngos grub thob par gyur sngags bcas brjod/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bzhag la tshe sngags brjod pas 'od du zhu nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud dang nus pas rtsa khams thams cad gang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brtan cing nus ldan du bsams la rjes chog bya/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod/ gnyis pa gzhan don du 'chi med tshe'i rjes gnang sbyin pa la/ sgrub pa dang 'brel na bdag don du dngos grub blang ba'i rjes su gtor ma 'od du zhu nas bstim pa mi byed par spyi bor bzhag nas sngags brjod pa'i rjes de ma thag par rjes su gnang ba byin pas chog ma 'brel na sbyor ba gnas khang yid du 'ong bar bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi rten bshams pa'i mdun du/ yi dam spyan ras gzigs la zlum gtor gcig mgon po'i gtor ma zur gsum che ba gcig la phyogs bzhir bshos bu gru gsum dbus ma'i sum gnyis tsam slebs pa/

mthar mtheb kyu nyer gcig gam/ lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'am brgya rtsa gcig gis bskor/ mda' dar dkar po gzugs/ de'i mdun du thun gtor snying gzugs ma/ g.yas su bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ g.yon du thod pa chang dang bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa dar dmar gyi khebs sbron skyogs bcas/ mthar mchod pa chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i bskor bsham bya/ dngos gzhi ni/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil sogs nas gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta'ang tshar gsum brjod pa'i bar spyi ltar bya/ de nas bdag bskyed gong bzhin thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba'i bar song rjes/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro bas phyi nang gi mchod pa bya/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ sgrub gtor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i hūm̐ re re/ de 'od du zhu ba las tsa turmu kha dkar po tshe 'phel gtso 'khor lnga bskyed pa nas/ gnyis su med par thim bar brjod/ gtor ma byin brlab/ gong ltar dbul/ bzlas pa mnyes byed bzlas dmigs spyi 'gre la/ tshe bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa gtso bo'i thugs ka nas chi li li babs pas bar gong bzhin/

de nas/ mdun bskyed kyi g.yas g.yon bum pa dang thod pa'i nang du babs pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ sngags gong bzhin bzla/ slar yang thugs ka sogs nas/ rnam par bsdus nas g.yas g.yon gyi sogs nas bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin dang*/ dbang phyug rab brtan gyis bum thod sbyin skabs/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ sogs brjod par gsungs pas/ sngags de nyid bzla bar 'dod na/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nri dzaḥ oṃ ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥbh+rūm̐ bin+dhu bin+dhu hūm̐ hūm̐ tshe bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ tshe bh+rūm̐ nṛ khug bin+dhu bh+rūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥpuṇ+ye puṇ+ye hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'ang ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la/ mthar 'dod don gsol ba btab la/ bdag dang rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi tshe'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang sogs gong bzhin brjod pa ni slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// slob ma la bya ba ni/ dbang gis smin cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab pa dang*/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa'i chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa lus drang por gnas pa sogs kyi 'dug stangs dang*/ sems kyis gnas khang ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po rdo rje'i srung 'khor gyi nang du chud pa dang*/ slob dpon yang rdo rje 'dzin pa dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyang lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ chos kyi sgra yang grags stong skye ba med pa srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad sel bar byed pa'i sgra lhang lhang yod snyam pa'i gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang nas yengs med du gsan par zhu/

de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las/ lus dang sems ni zhes sogs nas/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las zhes pa'i bar gong gi yig cha'i dbur bkod pa ltar brjod rjes/ dkar po tshe 'phel thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa 'bul ba'i skabs yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ slob dpon dang lhag pa'i lha tha mi dad snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis dang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes sbrel ba lan gsum/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ khyad par can gyi gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gsung bar zhu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la tsa turmu kha dkar po tshe 'phel gyi byin gyis rlob la rjes su gnang ba dang tshe'i dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ thog mar mdun bskyed sngar yod gsal gdab pa'i tshul du bskyed pa yin te/ mdun gyi gtor ma 'di nyid pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa dang nyi ma'i dbus su tsa turmu kha dkar po tshe 'phel sogs nas/ bzhugs pa bar brjod/ de yang sngon bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' bsgos dam la bzhag pa dang*/ rten 'brel gyi dbang gis mngon sum du bzhugs nges snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi lus dgod pa'i slad du thugs 'dun spyan dmigs 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas yi ge hūm̐ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas sku tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ sku lus rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po 'di nyid 'od gsal gyi dbyings su sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad dang 'od kyi gong bu de nyid kyang stong nyid nam mkha' lta bur gyur par mos pa mdzod/ stong nyid de'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba sogs nas/ gtso bo la zhal phyogs pas bzhugs pa bar bdag bskyed ltar/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal btab pa ni rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa yin/ rjes gnang dngos la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang mtha' rten dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa las/ sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas gangs ti se/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod/ siṅga la'i gling*/ dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang*/ gnas mchog kha'u brag rdzong*/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i gnas na bzhugs pa'i dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog pas/

thugs rgyud bskul te dpal mgon dkar po tshe 'phel 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad ye shes kyi mgon po gtso 'khor lnga'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ 'bring po mi tshad tsam/ chung ba nas 'bras dang rdul phran tsam gyi bar grangs med tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba lta bu 'ur 'ur thib thib byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dril gsil dang*/ bsnyen sngags tshar gsum gyi mthar/ ā be sha ya a a a/ ci rigs dang*/ gu gul gyi dud pa dang rol chen bya/ des sku'i rjes su gnang ba grub/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu sogs nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad sngags kyi rnam pa kha dog dkar po nam mkha' gang ba 'ur 'ur thib thib byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa la sogs pa'i gnas rnams nas mar sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dril gsil dang bsnyen sngags brjod pa 'dra/ bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng dang po gnyis pa gsum pa rnams chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi mtha' skor du dang pos sngar med gsar byung du 'khod/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa de la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne la tshe'i lha mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/

sngags phreng hūm̐ yig dang bcas pa la thim/ de las 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar zhing dwangs pa dpag tu med pa skya chi li li babs pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ lus sems thams cad bde ba chen pos khyab/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bsnyen sngags la spel tshig dang bcas pa lan gsum/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba de/ slob dpon gyis sngags kyi phreng bar bsgyur te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags phreng brtan cing nus ldan du byas par mos pa mdzod/ mgon po 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// slar yang me tog gtor la/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dkar po tshe 'phel gtso 'khor lnga'i gsung gsang sngags kyi nus mthu dang byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi thugs rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig des gsung gi rjes gnang grub/ gsum pa thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon la lhag pa'i lha dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer sogs nas/ thugs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad gri gug dang*/ thod khrag bum pa/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ nor bu sogs phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar mtshon cha'i rigs de rnams phan tshun gzengs shing 'khrugs pas tshe la bar du gcod pa'i tshogs thams cad rdul phran bzhin du tshar bcad/

slar gri gug sogs phyag mtshan rnams 'od sngon po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i rnam par zhu ste sku lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sib sib thim pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bsnyen sngags la ā be sha ya btags pa lan gsum brjod/ des thugs kyi rjes gnang grub/ bzhi pa mtha' rten du 'chi med tshe'i bum pa spyi bor bzhag pas thabs kyi ngo bo tshe chu dkar po shel zhu ba'i mdog ltar dkar ba spyi bo nas zhugs pa lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab/ sdig sgrib dag lus nor bu chu shel dkar po ltar 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par mos pa mdzod/ ngag tu bsnyen sngags dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sogs brjod la sbyin/ thod pa'i tshe chang nas sbyin la/ shes rab kyi ngo bo tshe'i bdud rtsi mtshal cog la ma'i mdog ltar dmar ba khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du gsol ba/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab pas lus dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par gyur te 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags brjod la bdud rtsi sbyin/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi mtha' rten bcas grub nas/ rjes la bzhi yod pa las/ dang po phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ slob dpon lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma lhar gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi dbu thog tu yer gyis byon pa la/ da ltar gyi rtsa ba'i bla mas dam tshig gi rdo rjes bka' bsgos pas steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu bka' bsgos pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags kyi de wī'i mjug tu/ sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/

grub chen dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ bsod snyoms pa chen po/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rjes sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen sogs dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bye brag tu rdo rje slob ma 'di'i lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs la bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun par yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i phrin las dang stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du rdo rje slob ma'i tshe'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag zhi zhing*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas gtor ma dang dbyer med pa'i dpal mgon dkar po tshe 'phel gtso 'khor lnga khyed rang rnams kyi dbu gtsug nas thim pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang mgon po'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brtan cing nus ldan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

gnyis pa yon tan sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ 'di lta bu'i rjes su gnang ba thob nas zhing skyong dbang po'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi man ngag dang*/ khyad par du tsa turmu kha dkar po tshe 'phel gyi bdag mdun gyi rnal 'byor la brten pa'i man ngag rnams nyan pa la dbang ba yin pas bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du zhus te rang gzhan la phan gdags pa'i sgo nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don ci nus su bsgrub pa la brtson par bya'o// gsum pa mi 'bral bar bsten cing gsang bar gdams pa ni/ 'di lta bu'i man ngag dang gtor ma bsngo ba rnams thun bzhi/ gsum/ gnyis/ tha na'ang thun re la brtson par bya ba sogs chos skyong mnyes pa'i thabs la 'bad pa dang*/ rjes gnang dang dngos grub skor rnams dam tshig dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi rna lam du mtshan tsam yang mi bsgrag cing*/ lta grub mi gcig pa dang*/ nyams len la mi brtson pa dag la bshad par mi bya/ 'di ston pa'i bla ma la rdo rje 'chang gi 'du shes bskyed/ dam tshig mtha' dag ci nus su bsrung*/ khyad par klu sgrub kyi lta ba'i srung ma yin pas dbu ma'i lta ba la shin tu gus par bya/ yum chen bzhi po bde mchog gi sgo mtshams ma bzhi khros pa yin pas bde mchog gi gdong brnyan la'ang gus pa dang*/ gzhan bya nag khyi nag mi nag po la sdang bar mi bya zhing bsnyen bkur bya ba rnams dam tshig dang bslab bya yin no// bzhi pa de ltar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams mdor bsdus te 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod dbul ba/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams spyi ltar dang*/ rjes kyi rim pa gong bzhin bya'o// slar smras pa/ rdo rje zhal bzhi'i rnam 'gyur zla shel ltar// rab dkar gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i 'od bzang po// cung zad phye las grub pa'i dge tshogs kyis// 'gro kun tshe dang ye shes 'phel gyur cig/

//de ltar dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dkar po tshe 'phel 'di la gnyan lo tsā ba dang*/ theg chen chos rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung la brten nas tshar chen rdo rje 'chang sogs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi rim pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ gsang sgrub kyi las sbyor thun min skabs sogs su byung ba'i man ngag zab la gnyan pa mang du bzhugs pa'i nang nas phyi sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas tshe sgrub pa'i rim pa skyabs mchog thar rtse mchog sprul dam pa'i gsung gi dgongs don ltar tshar chen rdo rje 'chang dang*/ rmor chen rin po che/ 'jam mgon sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros rnams kyis rtsal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ji lta bar/ dpal sde dge lhun grub steng gi shar bla ming kun dga' dpal ldan pas mgon khang bdud dpung zil gnon du yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin dge ba'i legs tshogs dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bris pa/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing bstan 'gror phan bde mtha' yas pa 'byung ba dang*/ snyom las pa'ang skyabs mchog dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ngom pa med par rol zhing ci byed bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
